## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Plugins: `npm run plugins:validate` passes, `version` bumped if an existing plugin changed, and `npm run marketplace` run and committed (`marketplace.json` + `MARKETPLACE.md`)
- [ ] Plugins: no Node modules, `eval`, network requests, or code downloaded at run time
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot in light and dark mode
